theorems.statement: ∀ (P j m n' : ℕ) (g : Fin (j + 1) → Euclid P) (h₂ : n' = j + (m + 1)) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (RY : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (r : ℝ), Orthonormal ℝ g → RY.Represents Y → RY.measure ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g))ᗮ : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 → 0 < r → ∃ E' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n', IsIntegerMultiplicity E' ∧ E'.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ((j : ℝ) + 1) * (2 * r) ^ j) * RY.measure univ ∧ ∀ flatF : Fin (j + 1) → Covector (Euclid P) n' → Covector (Euclid P) (m + 1), (∀ (a : Fin (j + 1)) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n') (v : Fin (m + 1) → Euclid P), flatF a α v = α (Fin.append (g ∘ a.succAbove) v ∘ Fin.cast h₂)) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n', E' ω = ∑ a : Fin (j + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (a : ℕ) * ((∫ s in {s | s ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (g ∘ a.succAbove)) ∧ ∀ c, |inner ℝ (g (a.succAbove c)) s| ≤ r}, currentEval Y (fun y => flatF a ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n') (s + r • g a + y))) ∂μHE[j]) - ∫ s in {s | s ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (g ∘ a.succAbove)) ∧ ∀ c, |inner ℝ (g (a.succAbove c)) s| ≤ r}, currentEval Y (fun y => flatF a ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n') (s - r • g a + y))) ∂μHE[j])
